name: ListCodeSources

parameters.help_en: The display name of the code configuration. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 代码配置的显示名称，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The page number of the code configuration list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 代码配置列表的页码。起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The field used for sorting. Valid values:
GmtModifyTime: the time when the code source was last modified.
DisplayName: the display name.
CodeSourceId: the code source ID.
GmtCreateTime (default): the time when the code source was created
parameters.help_zh:
用于排序的字段名，取值如下：
GmtModifyTime：代码源修改时间。
DisplayName：展示名称。
CodeSourceId：代码源ID。
GmtCreateTime（默认值）：代码源创建时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order for the specified field in a paged query. Valid values:
ASC (default): ascending order.
DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，对指定的排序字段进行升序或降序。取值：
ASC（默认值）：升序。
DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. This parameter is required. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID（必填）。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id
